full_judgment:
ATM Afzal CJ: Plaintiff-respondents' suit for declaration of title and confirmation of possession, OC Suit No. 371 of 1980 of the Court of Assistant Judge, Natore in which the defendant-petitioner filed a joint written statement with other defendants was decreed ex-parte on 30-8-1988 and on an application under Order 9 rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure, the ex parte decree was set aside and the suit restored by order dated 16-2-1992 in Miscellaneous Case No.72 of 1988 on terms of payment of cost of Taka 600.00 not on the finding that the defendant was prevented by sufficient cause from appearing but “ন্যায় বিচারের খাতিরে”| 

 3. Seeking leave to appeal from the aforesaid judgment and order, Mr, Sultan Ahmed, learned Advocate for the defendant-petitioner, variously tried to justify the order of the learned Assistant Judge but the fact remained that the petitioner did not adduce any evidence as to his alleged illness preventing him from appearing in court while the suit was called on for hearing. So, the miscellaneous case was decided on mere assertion which was denied. There is thus no substance in any argument.
